verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws: the 'NEW NIGHT SERUM' eyebrow drops below the body copy and the logo is pushed to the bottom (wrong reading order), the bottle is jammed against the top and bottom canvas edges, and the leaf background is reduced to scraps. A's text block sits more evenly within the card. B's text sits low, so the Lumen & Fig logo nearly touches the bottom of the card, and its CTA is pushed toward the right edge with a large empty gap in the middle, so A is marginally better.
